name_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚/部落多元/资源：万部落共识与资源联邦制
name_en: Papua New Guinea/Tribal Diversity/Resources: Myriad Tribes Consensus & Resource Federalism
description_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚 800+ 语言/1000+ 部落/2000+ 派系/1975 独立/万图克/索马雷/奥尼尔/马拉佩/资源(黄金/铜/天然气/林业/渔业/棕榈油)/布干维尔内战(1988-98)/2019 公投/部落共识(沃恩托克/大人物/补偿/和解)/资源地主制/土地传统所有制。体现 M203 万部落共识 — 以"部落共识+大人物调解+资源地主+传统土地法"四位一体，在极度碎片化/资源诅咒/内战/国家建设四重挑战中构建部落联邦国家。
description_en: Papua New Guinea 800+ languages/1000+ tribes/2000+ factions/1975 independence/Wantok/Somare/O'Neill/Marape/resources(gold/copper/gas/forestry/fisheries/palm oil)/Bougainville civil war (1988-98)/2019 referendum/tribal consensus(wantok/big man/compensation/reconciliation)/resource landowner system/customary land tenure. Exemplifies M203 Myriad Tribes Consensus — quaternity of 'tribal consensus + big man mediation + resource landowner + customary land law' building tribal federal nation amid quadruple challenges of extreme fragmentation/resource curse/civil war/state-building.
reason_zh: 巴新非单纯资源国家，而是"万部落+万语言+大人物"三位一体部落联邦。800+ 语言世界最多，部落共识决策/大人物调解/补偿替代监狱，资源项目需地主同意。M203 区隔于 M187 酋长制(加纳)、M198 内陆枢纽(老挝)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)，核心在于"部落即政治单位+大人物即调解算法+补偿即司法"的美拉尼西亚部落联邦范式。
reason_en: PNG not mere resource state but 'myriad tribes + myriad languages + big man' trinity tribal federalism. 800+ languages world's most, tribal consensus decision/big man mediation/compensation replaces prison, resource projects need landowner consent. M203 distinct from M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M198 Landlocked Hub (Laos), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), core: 'tribe as political unit + big man as mediation algorithm + compensation as justice' Melanesian tribal federal paradigm.
steps_zh: 万部落共识决策机制：部落/氏族/语言群/沃恩托克网络/共识/长者/大人物/补偿/和解/零监狱/恢复性司法
大人物调解算法：大人物/财富再分配/声望/调解/婚姻/战争/和平/补偿/猪/贝壳/现代货币/政治权力
资源地主制与土地法：传统土地 97%/地主公司/版税/股权/利益分享/自由事先知情同意/FPIC/矿山/油气/林业/棕榈油
布干维尔自决与和解：1988-98 内战/2万+ 死亡/2001 和平/2019 公投/97.7% 独立/自治/和解/资源/国家建设
国家建设与碎片化治理：议会/联盟/不稳定/不信任/大人物政治/腐败/基建/教育/卫生/部落联邦制探索
steps_en: Myriad tribes consensus mechanism: tribes/clans/language groups/wantok networks/consensus/elders/big men/compensation/reconciliation/zero prison/restorative justice
Big man mediation algorithm: big man/wealth redistribution/prestige/mediation/marriage/war/peace/compensation/pigs/shells/modern currency/political power
Resource landowner system & land law: customary land 97%/landowner companies/royalties/equity/benefit sharing/FPIC/mines/oil gas/forestry/palm oil
Bougainville self-determination & reconciliation: 1988-98 civil war/20k+ deaths/2001 peace/2019 referendum/97.7% independence/autonomy/reconciliation/resources/state-building
State-building & fragmentation governance: parliament/coalitions/instability/votes of no confidence/big man politics/corruption/infra/education/health/tribal federalism exploration
expected_zh: 以"部落共识+大人物调解+资源地主+传统土地法"四位一体，在极度碎片化/资源诅咒/内战/国家建设四重挑战中构建部落联邦国家，为美拉尼西亚部落社会提供治理范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'tribal consensus + big man mediation + resource landowner + customary land law' builds tribal federal nation amid quadruple challenges of extreme fragmentation/resource curse/civil war/state-building, providing governance paradigm for Melanesian tribal societies.
